description.value: Crash Hotel Squamish is a hip boutique hotel perched above one of Squamish's liveliest bars and nightclubs, blending hostel energy with hotel privacy in the heart of downtown. Rooms feature mountain-inspired designs — think vintage ski equipment and original artwork — with many offering views of the Stawamus Chief. Situated on the Sea to Sky Highway between Vancouver and Whistler, it operates entirely digitally with keyless entry and 24/7 text-based guest support.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms all OSM contact details (phone, address, email, website all match exactly). The site lists 'Baggage Storage' and 'Wifi' as confirmed amenities and describes an on-site bar/nightclub with a walkable downtown of restaurants and breweries. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, leaving both required WWC criteria unconfirmable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Crash Hotel Squamish is a legitimate, active hotel in a prime Sea to Sky cycling corridor, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is confirmed by the website. Direct contact is needed to verify cyclist-specific facilities before listing.
